title: Overseas racing English-Japanese dictionary — racecourse facilities
note: JRA directly maps chute to シュート／ポケット, bend to コーナー and grandstand to グランドスタンド in racing-facility terminology. Use as label/sense evidence without treating one regional geometry as universal.

title: anti-clockwise
note: JRA directly maps anti-clockwise to 左回り and cross-references left-handed.

title: clockwise
note: JRA directly maps clockwise to 右回り and cross-references right-handed.

title: BHA General Instructions — Section 3 The Racecourse
note: Current BHA instructions define running rails as the rails horses run between during a race and prescribe winning-post siting, alignment and safety. Use for British racecourse infrastructure senses.

title: barn
note: JRA maps barn to 厩舎／馬舎 and cross-references stable. The Concept remains North American/regional in preferred racing usage even though the dictionary is international-facing.

title: Equibase — racehorse profile guide
note: JRA's current Equibase profile guide explicitly defines R (Ridgling) as an entire male with one or both testes not descended into the scrotum.

title: Longines World's Best Racehorse Rankings — 2026 sex-code key
note: The current international ranking key uses R = Rig/Ridgling, supporting Rig as a reporting label for the same sex-condition class without claiming a uniquely British definition.

title: Hawkesbury weights — 8 April 2026
note: Current official race data explicitly publishes Four-Years-Old and Upwards conditions and individual Age=4 runners, directly supporting the four-year-old age classification.

title: On foal registration, horse name registration and racehorse registration
note: JRA guidance explicitly uses foreign-bred horses for horses already named/registered abroad and ties the label to country-of-birth registration context. Use only for the Japan-facing foreign-bred classification rather than asserting one global eligibility rule.

title: assistant trainer
note: JRA directly maps assistant trainer to 調教師助手／調教助手 in racing-training terminology.

title: 厩舎スタッフの仕事
note: JRA defines stable staff as people working under the trainer who care for racehorses and describes daily horse-care, preparation, training-support and post-training duties. Employment structure is Japan-specific.

title: International Agreement on Breeding, Racing and Wagering — Article 12
note: IFHA Article 12 requires exact date and country of foaling and identifies the country of foaling for Stud Book recording. This supports foaled/foaling as an official pedigree-registration birth expression; detailed registration rules remain Thoroughbred-system-specific.
